title: KoboldCpp
summary: Local GGUF inference runtime and generation UIs; publishes OpenAI-compatible APIs for roleplay frontends but is not a complete memory/character management solution.
documentation_observations: README documents bundled web UIs, GGUF support and OpenAI-compatible endpoint at localhost:5001/v1.
Backend only for most portability/memory requirements; model quality varies by selected weights.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
